# Load data

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE

library(tidyverse)

#load data
smart1 <- read.csv2("smartc.csv")

smart1 <- smart1 %>%
  mutate(
    # Binary yes/no variables
    EVENT     = factor(EVENT,     levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    DIABETES  = factor(DIABETES,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    CEREBRAL  = factor(CEREBRAL,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    CARDIAC   = factor(CARDIAC,   levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    AAA       = factor(AAA,       levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    PERIPH    = factor(PERIPH,    levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    STENOSIS  = factor(STENOSIS,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("no", "yes")),
    
    # Binary but coded 1/2
    SEX       = factor(SEX,       levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("male", "female")),
    
    # Multi-level nominal/ordinal variables
    SMOKING   = factor(SMOKING,   levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("never", "former", "current")),
    alcohol   = factor(alcohol,   levels = c(1, 2, 3), labels = c("never", "former", "current")),
    albumin   = factor(albumin, levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                       labels = c("no", "micro", "macro"),
                       ordered = TRUE))

#change data types to numeric if necessary
smart1 <- smart1 %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric))

```

# Logistic Regression Model

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE

model <- glm(EVENT ~ AGE + SEX + BMI + SYSTH + HDL + DIABETES + HISTCAR2 +
               HOMOC + log(CREAT) + STENOSIS + IMT + SMOKING + alcohol + albumin,
             data = smart1, family = binomial)

```

# Question A

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE

# same proportion in every fold, check if that is correct
# way of validating the final model of part 1 with no external data available

library(caret)

set.seed(1234)

folds <- createFolds(smart1$EVENT, k = 10, returnTrain = TRUE)

train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  index = folds 
)

model_glm <- train(
  EVENT ~ AGE + SEX + BMI + SYSTH + HDL + DIABETES + HISTCAR2 +
    HOMOC + log(CREAT) + STENOSIS + IMT + SMOKING + alcohol + albumin,
  data = smart1,
  method = "glm",
  family = "binomial",
  trControl = train_control
)
```
